name: pacing-mod
description: Usage pacing pane for Claude Code: 5-hour and weekly limits, even-pace marker, burn-rate forecast. Works in the Desktop Code tab and VS Code, where the status line does not run.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colour theme for the pacing bars. status-bar follows colour_theme in ~/.claude/statusline.conf.

band.title: Desktop band
band.description: Show the one-line pacing band above the prompt in the Desktop app and VS Code.

context.title: Context card
context.description: Show the context window card (fill, tokens, auto-compact point) in the pane and band.

session.title: Session row
session.description: Show the session's duration and cost under the cards.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Toast once per window when you are on track to hit a limit, or pass 90%.

notify.title: Native notifications
notify.description: Also raise a native notification (your preferredNotifChannel) for the same alerts, so they reach you when the window is not in front.
